learning_objectives.en: Use natural contractions and respond to Part 2 and Part 3 prompts.
learning_objectives.vi: Dùng dạng rút gọn tự nhiên và phát triển ý cho Part 2, Part 3 mà vẫn dễ nghe.

content.vi: I have thành I’ve có thể làm lời nói tự nhiên hơn, nhưng phát âm phải rõ. Ghi từ khóa cho Part 2, rồi ở Part 3 mở rộng bằng lý do và ví dụ.
content.en: Contractions can sound natural when clear. Use keywords for Part 2 and expand reasons and examples in Part 3.

strategies.vi: Làm bài trước khi xem đáp án; ghi lại câu chưa chắc và giải thích vì sao đáp án đúng.
strategies.en: Attempt the task first, then explain why the supported answer is right.

passages.title: S-A
passages.text: Speaking about education often requires candidates to describe systems, explain causes and effects, and make suggestions using modal verbs such as should and must. In longer answers, students should link ideas clearly and give examples.

questions.prompt_en: Speaking Part 2: Describe a problem with the education system in your country.
questions.prompt_vi: Speaking Part 2: Describe a problem with the education system in your country.

answer.model_en: One problem in my country is exam pressure. It has existed for many years and can make students anxious. Schools and the government should promote more balanced assessment.
answer.model_vi: One problem in my country is exam pressure. It has existed for many years and can make students anxious. Schools and the government should promote more balanced assessment.

questions.prompt_en: Speaking Part 3: What is the effect of private tutoring on education?
questions.prompt_vi: Speaking Part 3: What is the effect of private tutoring on education?

answer.model_en: Private tutoring can help some students improve quickly, but it may also increase inequality because not every family can afford it.
answer.model_vi: Private tutoring can help some students improve quickly, but it may also increase inequality because not every family can afford it.

questions.prompt_en: Speaking Part 3: What more can governments do to reduce the need for private tutoring?
questions.prompt_vi: Speaking Part 3: What more can governments do to reduce the need for private tutoring?

answer.model_en: Governments can improve public-school quality, provide free support classes and reduce overly competitive exams.
answer.model_vi: Governments can improve public-school quality, provide free support classes and reduce overly competitive exams.

questions.prompt_en: Speaking Part 3: How can we encourage more parents to teach their children at home?
questions.prompt_vi: Speaking Part 3: How can we encourage more parents to teach their children at home?

answer.model_en: Schools could give parents simple learning guides and regular suggestions for short activities at home.
answer.model_vi: Schools could give parents simple learning guides and regular suggestions for short activities at home.
